thesis: The most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the add-to-cart and checkout flow, but it is bleeding value through conflicting cart feedback after adding an item, which undermines shopper confidence at the critical moment of purchase intent.

findings.title: Heavy third-party script load
findings.summary: The homepage loads 56 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.problem: The homepage loads 56 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Audit third-party tags, defer non-critical scripts, and remove duplicated analytics or marketing pixels.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 inline and 15 external <script> tags, 300 KB of HTML.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Homepage next step is ambiguous
findings.summary: The homepage presents multiple unrelated CTAs and social follow headings, leaving no clear primary direction into the purchase path.
findings.problem: The homepage presents multiple unrelated CTAs and social follow headings, leaving no clear primary direction into the purchase path.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Shop new arrivals; cta: Shop now; notes: Single dominant browse CTA
findings.evidence: 5 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “Create account”, “Check out”, “Shop now”, “See More”, “shop@domesticdomestic.com”. | The page's main headline reads “Follow us on Instagram”. | The page's main headline reads “Follow us on Facebook”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Clarify culturally charged tagline
findings.summary: The tagline is followed by a sale banner and category list, but lacks plain-language explanation of the brand's point of difference.
findings.problem: The tagline is followed by a sale banner and category list, but lacks plain-language explanation of the brand's point of difference.
findings.evidence: Culturally Charged Accoutrement Bags Travel Kits Key Chains Wallets Sunglasses Watches | ADDITIONAL 20% OFF ON SALE ITEMS | SHOP SALE!
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Ambiguous Accoutrement nav label
findings.summary: The brand tagline 'Culturally Charged Accoutrement' runs into the category list, and a separate 'Accoutrement' category appears, confusing shoppers.
findings.problem: The brand tagline 'Culturally Charged Accoutrement' runs into the category list, and a separate 'Accoutrement' category appears, confusing shoppers.
findings.evidence: Culturally Charged Accoutrement Bags Travel Kits Key Chains Wallets Sunglasses Watches | Jewelry Accoutrement Office Books
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Weak page metadata
findings.summary: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.problem: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
findings.evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title present, og:image present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Conflicting cart feedback after add
findings.summary: The cart drawer simultaneously shows 'Item added' and 'View my cart (0)', confusing shoppers about whether their item was added.
findings.problem: The cart drawer simultaneously shows 'Item added' and 'View my cart (0)', confusing shoppers about whether their item was added.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Check out; notes: Update cart count in success message
findings.evidence: Item added to your cart View my cart (0) Check out Continue shopping
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Sale promo competes with checkout
findings.summary: The sitewide sale banner on the cart page offers an exit from the purchase path at the final step before conversion.
findings.problem: The sitewide sale banner on the cart page offers an exit from the purchase path at the final step before conversion.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Your cart; cta: Check out; notes: Remove or de-emphasize sale banner
findings.evidence: ADDITIONAL 20% OFF ON SALE ITEMS | SHOP SALE! | 4 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “Create account”, “Check out”, “See More”, “shop@domesticdomestic.com”. | The page's main headline reads “Your cart”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Gift card prices ambiguous
findings.summary: Gift card amounts render without decimal separators, leaving the actual price unclear and potentially misleading.
findings.problem: Gift card amounts render without decimal separators, leaving the actual price unclear and potentially misleading.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Account creation precedes checkout
findings.summary: Create account is promoted ahead of Check out in the cart area, adding a non-purchase step to the primary conversion path.
findings.problem: Create account is promoted ahead of Check out in the cart area, adding a non-purchase step to the primary conversion path.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Check out; notes: Check out first, guest checkout available
findings.evidence: 4 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “Create account”, “Check out”, “See More”, “shop@domesticdomestic.com”. | Menu Search Log in Create account 0 Cart Item added to your cart View my cart (0) Check out Continue shopping
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Order change page pushes checkout
findings.summary: The page meant for changing an order offers checkout as the visible action, forcing users to find another route for their actual task.
findings.problem: The page meant for changing an order offers checkout as the visible action, forcing users to find another route for their actual task.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Making Changes to Your Order; cta: Manage my order; notes: Add explicit manage action
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Making Changes to Your Order”. | 3 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “Create account”, “Check out”, “shop@domesticdomestic.com”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
